text:
After escaping Dubai when the Iran war began, I found myself in Bangkok. I’ve always wanted to get veneers done due to tetracycline staining on my top teeth but the cost of it in the US is so high! It was the perfect opportunity for me to get it done at Thantakit. I had inquired about pricing a couple of years ago but didn’t have any concrete plans to go to Thailand to get it done. I called them on Friday and they were able to squeeze me in the next day. I had my consultation and got a cleaning done and came back Monday for my prep work. My temporary veneers cracked the next day which was unfortunate as I couldn’t enjoy a lot of food during my trip but the results were well worth it. My final placement was a week later and the final follow up for adjustments was the next day. It took 10 days in total. Dr. J (Dr. Adison Jirasuwannakul) did my veneers. I just recently went to my regular dentist and I felt ashamed, kind of like I cheated on him because he knew I wanted veneers done and I always talked about doing them with him. Anyway, my dentist was so thrilled for me and said they looked wonderful. The color was great and upon looking at my x-rays, he said the veneers were perfectly overlapped and that doesn’t always happen. He said my veneers were done extremely well. I was happy with my smile but as I’m not a dentist, I didn’t know if they were done properly so it was wonderful to hear from my dentist whom I trust explicitly to say that my veneers were done extremely well.

I also had my 1 year old and 4 year old son with me and I asked if the clinic could watch him during my follow up appointments and they were so willing. My husband ended up being able to watch them so I didn’t bring them along but the staff asked where my little kids were!! That was so sweet. They also will pick you up from the hotel and drop you off so you don’t need to worry about transportation.

I highly recommend this clinic. It’s always scary to get any procedures done especially in a foreign country where English is not there first language but this place was wonderful.

text:
I had an absolutely outstanding experience at Thantakit and can recommend them with full confidence.

I travelled from Singapore to Bangkok for fairly extensive dental treatment over the course of three days and numerous appointments, and the clinic exceeded my expectations in every way. From the very beginning, their communication was clear, transparent, professional, and incredibly efficient. They explained the treatment plan, staging, timeline, and costs very clearly, which made it so much easier to plan from abroad.

What stood out to me most was how organized and capable the team was. In one weekend, they managed a significant amount of treatment while still making me feel calm, informed, and very well cared for. Besides, It was possibly the least painful experience I ever had for such heavy procedures. I never before found myself in a situation where I had to ask the dentist whether I have already received the injection because I was feeling the numbness kick in!!!

I especially want to mention Dr. Jenjira (General dentist), who really gave me the feeling that she cares deeply about saving teeth whenever possible and does not take decisions lightly. I truly appreciated her warm, non-judgemental, and clear approach.

I also want to thank Dr. Chatruethai, who was an extremely skilled implantologist and made me feel deeply informed every step of the way. That made a huge difference to me, especially during a treatment process that could otherwise have felt quite overwhelming.

Overall, the whole team was extraordinarily kind, professional, reassuring, and clearly very experienced with international patients. I came to Bangkok hoping to find a strong and more affordable alternative to treatment in Singapore, and I genuinely feel I found not only a better-value option, but also an excellent clinic with OUTSTANDING service.

If you are considering dental treatment in Thailand, especially more complex work such as implants, crowns, restorative treatment, or cosmetic dentistry, I would highly recommend Thantakit. My experience was extremely positive, and I am very happy I chose them.

restaurant_name: Thantakit International Dental Center in Bangkok, Thailand
text:
Late last year I travelled to Bangkok for dental treatment at Thantakit Dental Center.The Dental Center is exceptionally clean and the staff are friendly, kind and efficient. Por, the lady coordinating my treatment, was extremely competent and spoke very good English, as did most of the dentists and staff that I met. All dental sub specialities are catered for at Thantakit.
I made two trips, the first being for deep cleaning, 5 root canals and 1 extraction, (all completely pain free). These procedures were in preparation for the fitting of multiple crowns, which was carried out during my second trip.

I had received a written quotation for the work based on X rays and photographs prior to travelling to Bangkok. My front teeth were in a very cracked and worn condition and I was to have up to 26 crowns fitted.
When I arrived I was introduced to Dr Piyaorn Taksaphan, who was to be my prosthodontist. After examining my teeth Dr Piyaorn suggested that I have crowns only on my front teeth since my back teeth were healthy and I ended up getting 8 upper and 6 lower crowns with the price reduced accordingly.
I had told Dr Piyaorn of  my wish to have natural looking teeth, particularly for them to not be too white and artificial looking and she took great care to find a suitable shade. My temporary crowns were in two slightly different shades of white, top and bottom, so that I could assess which I preferred and get the opinion of family members prior to installation of my permanent crowns. These were fitted a week later and are just marvelous !  I returned a few days after this and Dr Piyaorn spent quite some time making minor adjustments until my bite was completely comfortable.
I am ecstatic with the results of my treatment and highly recommend Thantakit Dental Centre for any type of dental treatment.

Thank you Dr Piyaorn and everyone at Thantakit for giving  my smile back to me!

text:
Like so many other reviews have said - I can't recommend  Thantakit International  Dental Center enough. Specifically, Dr. Chinda Numkarunarunroke  and  her team for  the amazing care.  When I researched dental clinics in Bangkok, Thantakit Dental Center and Dr. Numkarunarunroke repeatedly came up as some of the best reviewed and I now know why.   I had 8 porcelain veneers and a root canal in October 2025.  I could not believe how painless and  gentle the treatment was.  It was just 2 visits for the veneers (and a seperate one for RC).   The first visit was a few hours but still not nearly as long as I expected and I left with  temporaries  that were  absolutely fine while I waited a week for my PERFECT 8 veneers.   On my second appointment 8 days later, Dr. Numkarunarunroke  installed the 8 porcelain veneers which look absolutley beautiful. They look like I was born with perfect teeth ! Nothing 'fake' looking about them.  I opted for a shade or 2 below the whitest so they would look realistic  especially for someone a little older.  The length, the shape, my bite, the color couldn't be more perfect.    I traveled from NYC specifically to see Dr. Chinda Numkarunarunroke and although there places a little  closer, I've yet to see any work that looks as realistic and  natural  as what I got at Thantakit Dental Center and the bonus is - you get to spend time in beautiful Bangkok.    Its recommended to stay for a day or two in case there are any adjustments that need to be made.   I did not need any but glad I had the flexibilty to stay.     I was perfectly comfortable flying back to NYC  72 hours after my last visit.

A quick update:   I returned to Dr. Chinda Numkarunarunroke in February 2026 to get  8 lower veneers (and a crown replaced to match)  done.  Again,  it was a painless procedure with stunning results.  I still can't believe these are my teeth !      Yes, I could have had upper and lower done in my first trip but,  I had the time to spread out the procedures and didn't reallize how easy, painless, and affordable it would be. I stayed in BKK for 11 days which was just enough time to get the work done. Aside from some minor aches on first day, I was able to enjoy the weather, shopping and dining out between first and final visit.

My teeth were in ok shape but  I realized they were never going to get any whiter at my age with Zoom or home kits etc.  I take care of myself and do what I can to fight off the signs of aging -  Dr. Numkarunarunroke's work  took   years off my smile. I'm so much happier with the way I look especially in photos.

I would also like to mention Miss Bam at the Front Desk and Dr. Numkarunarunroke's  assistants who were all wonderful.

When we got to the clinic, they sent us for an X-ray of the entire jaw for some reason. They didn't say a word about the price, and the procedure itself took 5 minutes.

When we checked in, they quoted 5,400.
The X-rays were 1,400 for the entire jaw. Why?

The deletion itself cost 4,000 baht. They literally took no more than 5 minutes, but then they explained how complicated it was.

text:
Six Dental Implants, Upper Jaw — Thantakit International Dental Center

As a maritime consultant, I spend my working life assessing ships standards, precision, and reliability — qualities I don't take lightly, whether on a vessel or in a clinic.

My experience at Thantakit over the past two to three weeks in Bangkok met that same bar in every respect.  I underwent a full upper jaw restoration with six implants, and the professionalism throughout was outstanding. The technology, equipment, and materials used reflected genuinely international standards, and every step was clearly explained.

What stood out most was the personal attention — the staff's warmth and care made a demanding treatment feel like a genuinely positive experience.
That balance of clinical excellence and human touch is rare.

I'll be back in Bangkok soon for a follow-up review of the implants, and I'm looking forward to seeing this excellent team again.  Highly recommended.
